sources.entry: OpenAI Translator - Translation app and browser extension powered by AI models. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/yetone/openai-translator) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: An AI-powered translator app and browser extension (renamed NextAI Translator) that handles translation, polishing and summarization using OpenAI or other LLM providers.
summary.what_it_does: The project provides translation, text polishing and summarization modes across 55 languages, with streaming output, customizable translation prompts, one-click copying and text-to-speech. It is offered as a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux and as a browser extension, and it supports screenshot translation. It includes a vocabulary book feature that can generate memory aids from saved words. Users supply their own API key for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI Service, TeamoRouter or MiniMax, and can optionally route OpenAI calls through a proxy. The README includes install steps for Windows and macOS and instructions for configuring the Azure OpenAI endpoint.
use_cases: polish or rewrite writing in another language
summarize long text with an LLM
build a personal vocabulary list with memory aids
use ChatGPT-style models for translation without a paid app
how_to_run: Windows: download the .exe from the Latest Release page and run the installer
macOS: download the .dmg matching your chip (aarch64 for Apple Silicon) from the Latest Release page and install it
If macOS blocks the app, run: sudo xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/NextAI\ Translator.app
Browser extension: install from your browser's extension store, then enter your API key in the extension settings
Obtain an OpenAI or Azure OpenAI Service API key (or a TeamoRouter key) and select the provider in Settings
notable: Supports three modes: translation, polishing and summarization
Screenshot translation and text-to-speech built in
Vocabulary books with memory aid generation from saved words
Works with multiple LLM providers, including Azure OpenAI Service and a built-in TeamoRouter option
caveats: The project was renamed to NextAI Translator after a trademark warning from OpenAI, so older names may appear in listings
Requires your own API key from a paid LLM provider
macOS builds are not verified by Apple, so users may need to run a terminal command or change security settings to open them
Apple Silicon users must pick the aarch64 build
